faces.name: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin
faces.oracleText:
Flying, trample
Whenever one or more opponents each lose exactly 1 life, put a +1/+1 counter on Ob Nixilis. Exile the top card of your library. Until your next end step, you may play that card.

cards.name: Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath

faces.name: Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath
faces.oracleText:
+2: Each opponent loses 1 life. You gain life equal to the life lost this way.
−2: Create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying. You lose 2 life.
−8: You get an emblem with "{1}{B}, Sacrifice a creature: You gain X life and draw X cards, where X is the sacrificed creature's power."
Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath can be your commander.

faces.name: Ob Nixilis Reignited
faces.oracleText:
+1: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
−3: Destroy target creature.
−8: Target opponent gets an emblem with "Whenever a player draws a card, you lose 2 life."

faces.name: Ob Nixilis's Cruelty
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

faces.name: Ob Nixilis, the Adversary
faces.oracleText:
Casualty X. The copy isn't legendary and has starting loyalty X. (As you cast this spell, you may sacrifice a creature with power X. When you do, copy this spell. The copy becomes a token.)
+1: Each opponent loses 2 life unless they discard a card. If you control a Demon or Devil, you gain 2 life.
−2: Create a 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
−7: Target player draws seven cards and loses 7 life.

faces.name: Ob Nixilis, the Ascended
faces.oracleText:
Flying
When Ob Nixilis enters, destroy all tapped creatures your opponents control. You gain 1 life for each creature destroyed this way.
At the beginning of each end step, if you gained life this turn, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying.

faces.name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
faces.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may have target player lose 3 life. If you do, put three +1/+1 counters on Ob Nixilis.

faces.name: Ob Nixilis, the Hate-Twisted
faces.oracleText:
Whenever an opponent draws a card, Ob Nixilis deals 1 damage to that player.
−2: Destroy target creature. Its controller draws two cards.
